Pillars of flame turn the mightiest to ash. All others tremble in shock and awe.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 21 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes, and at a +2 bonus to Conceal/Reveal Object

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Incendiary Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition and sets the target Strongly on Fire (4 HP damage a Turn) instead of Mildly on Fire. Ammunition bought for this weapon can only be used by this weapon. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged, this weapon functions as ROF 1 and deals 3d6 additional damage, dropping the lowest 2 rolls (5d6, drop 2 lowest).

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
